name: Jonathan Nez
summary:
Jonathan Michael Nez (born May 26, 1975) is a Navajo and American politician who served as the ninth president of the Navajo Nation from 2019 to 2023. He previously served as vice president and as a delegate to the Navajo Nation Council. 
Nez represented the Tsah Bii' Kin, Navajo Mountain, Shonto, and Oljato chapters as a council delegate before being elected vice president in 2015 on a ticket with Russell Begaye.
